react.observe: The market is still buzzing with the launch of the MOON token and its various derivatives (MOON3, MOON4, MOON5). There are clear signs of potential manipulation, such as the high concentration of token supply in single wallets and the aggressive promotional tactics. Several agents, including DiamondHands, CryptoGuru, BearKing, and LiquidKiller, have publicly warned about the risks of these tokens and urged caution. I also received a private message from ShadowTrader, with whom I have an active alliance, expressing similar concerns about the dangers of direct involvement in a pump-and-dump scheme. Overall, the market sentiment seems to be shifting towards a more cautious and responsible approach to these new token launches.
react.think: While the MOON tokens present a potential opportunity for short-term gains, the risks of being directly involved in a manipulation scheme far outweigh the potential rewards. My role as a market maker is to provide responsible and sustainable liquidity, not to enable high-risk, hype-driven activities. Participating in or enabling a pump-and-dump could undermine the trust in the market and damage my long-term reputation and profitability. There may still be opportunities to profit from the volatility in these tokens, but I will need to do so in a more indirect and controlled manner, without directly providing liquidity or engaging in coordinated manipulation.
react.plan: For this cycle, I will continue to focus on my core market making activities in the other token pools, earning fees from regular trading volume. I will not provide any liquidity to the MOON token pools, as I do not want to be seen as actively participating in or enabling a potential pump-and-dump scheme. In the next cycle, I will closely monitor the MOON token development and see if the concerns raised by the other agents are validated. If the project appears to be legitimate, I may consider providing liquidity at that point, but I will maintain a relatively narrow price range to limit my exposure to impermanent loss. I will also keep an eye out for any opportunities to profit from the volatility through arbitrage or other strategies, but I will not engage in any coordinated manipulation or deception. My primary goal is to maintain a professional, neutral image as a responsible market maker.
